LanguageData.PhobosSonar_GizmoPingDesc: Send out a sonar ping. It finds everything hostile in the water within {RANGE} cells, moving or still, and every boat under the water, though one resting on the bottom only from half as far.\n\nThe ping is no secret: anyone in the water hears it from {HEARD} cells away, and a boat under the water is followed for {SECONDS} seconds as if it had been spotted. The set needs {COOLDOWN} seconds between pings.
LanguageData.PhobosSonar_RefuseOutOfWater: {VEHICLE}'s sonar only works in the water.
LanguageData.PhobosSonar_RefuseNobody: Nobody aboard {VEHICLE} is awake and able to work the sonar.
LanguageData.PhobosSonar_RefuseCooling: The sonar set is ready again in {SECONDS} seconds.
LanguageData.PhobosSonar_FoundNothing: {VEHICLE}'s ping finds nothing hostile within {RANGE} cells, and has been heard.
LanguageData.PhobosSonar_Found: {VEHICLE}'s ping finds {COUNT} hostile, the nearest {DISTANCE} cells to the {BEARING}. The ping has been heard.
LanguageData.PhobosSonar_FoundBoats: Boats under the water among them: {COUNT}, now followed.
LanguageData.PhobosSonar_PingHeard: {VEHICLE}'s crew hears a sonar ping from the {BEARING}.
